                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_owner = root
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_subject = scope:zg361_comp_open_subject
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_cycle = var:zg361_review_serial

                        AND = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade = 1 var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating = 325 }
                        AND = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade = 2 var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating = 350 }

zg361_comp_open_af_case_effect = {
    save_scope_as = zg361_comp_open_subject
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = {
                zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                has_variable = zg361_review_serial
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_cycle
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_owner
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_subject
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_cycle
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_case
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_state
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_snapshot_applied
                    }
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_cycle = var:zg361_review_serial
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = scope:zg361_comp_open_subject
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_owner = root
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_subject = scope:zg361_comp_open_subject
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_cycle = var:zg361_review_serial
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_state >= 3
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_snapshot_applied = 1
                    OR = {
                        AND = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade = 1 var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating = 325 }
                        AND = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade = 2 var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating = 350 }
                        AND = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade = 3 var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating = 375 }
                    }
                }
                trigger_else = { always = no }
            }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
        }
        zg361_case_af_open_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_result_owner value = root.var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_result_subject value = root.var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_subject }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_result_cycle value = root.var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_cycle }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_result_case value = root.var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_case }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_result_state value = root.var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_state }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_result_grade value = root.var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_result_rating value = root.var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_last_operation value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_last_route value = 0 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_treasury_available value = 100 }

    change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_l_bonus_accounted add = { value = 0 subtract = var:zg361_comp_bonus_returned } }
    change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_l_bonus_accounted add = var:zg361_comp_bonus_forfeited }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_l_bonus_conserved value = 0 }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_l_bonus_conserved value = 1 }
    }

zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_initialized = 0
            var:zg361_comp_m278_consumed = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m279_consumed = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m280_consumed = 1
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = zg361_comp_ae_extra_month_prorated
            value = {
                value = var:zg361_comp_m279_amount
                multiply = var:zg361_comp_m280_proration_bps
                divide = 10000
                floor = yes
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m279_contract_kind = 2
                var:zg361_comp_ae_frozen_performance_grade < 375
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_extra_month_prorated value = 0 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_comp_m279_contract_kind = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_extra_month_prorated value = 0 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable value = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_base }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable add = var:zg361_comp_ae_extra_month_prorated }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_paid value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed value = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_returned value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_initialized value = 1 }
    }
    # Mechanism 278 is necessarily consumed before 279/280 finish the
    # formula. Refresh its consumer-facing account snapshot after every
    # recalculation instead of freezing the pre-initialization zeroes.
    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m278_promised value = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m278_paid value = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_paid }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m278_owed value = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m278_returned value = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_returned }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_rhs value = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_paid }
    change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_rhs add = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed }
    change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_rhs add = { value = 0 subtract = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_returned } }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_conserved value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_rhs = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_conserved value = 1 }
    }
}

zg361_comp_af_recalculate_units_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:zg361_comp_af_periods_processed = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_total_units value = var:zg361_comp_af_grant_base_units }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_total_units add = var:zg361_comp_af_conversion_units }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_comp_m292_consumed = 1 var:zg361_comp_m292_risk_kind = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_total_units value = var:zg361_comp_af_conversion_units }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_service_bps value = 5000 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_comp_m297_consumed = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_service_bps value = var:zg361_comp_m297_service_bps }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = zg361_comp_af_service_original
            value = {
                value = var:zg361_comp_af_total_units
                multiply = var:zg361_comp_af_service_bps
                divide = 10000
                floor = yes
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = zg361_comp_af_performance_original
            value = {
                value = var:zg361_comp_af_total_units
                subtract = var:zg361_comp_af_service_original
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_unvested_service value = var:zg361_comp_af_service_original }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_unvested_performance value = var:zg361_comp_af_performance_original }
    }
    zg361_comp_af_check_conservation_effect = yes
}

zg361_comp_af_check_conservation_effect = {
    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_unit_accounted value = var:zg361_comp_af_unvested_service }
    change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_unit_accounted add = var:zg361_comp_af_unvested_performance }
    change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_unit_accounted add = var:zg361_comp_af_vested_units }
    change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_unit_accounted add = var:zg361_comp_af_forfeited_units }
    change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_unit_accounted add = var:zg361_comp_af_repurchased_units }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_unit_conserved value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:zg361_comp_af_unit_accounted = var:zg361_comp_af_total_units }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_unit_conserved value = 1 }
    }
}

zg361_comp_ae_freeze_due_obligation_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            var:zg361_comp_ae_due_resolved = 0
            var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed >= 2
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_frozen_gross value = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed }
        set_variable = {
            name = zg361_comp_ae_due_frozen_treasury
            value = { value = var:zg361_comp_ae_due_frozen_gross multiply = 0.7 add = 0.5 floor = yes }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = zg361_comp_ae_due_frozen_personal
            value = { value = var:zg361_comp_ae_due_frozen_gross subtract = var:zg361_comp_ae_due_frozen_treasury }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_obligation_treasury_payer value = var:zg361_case_ae_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_obligation_personal_payer value = var:zg361_case_ae_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_obligation_recipient value = this }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_obligation_approver value = var:zg361_case_ae_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_obligation_frozen_owner value = var:zg361_case_ae_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_obligation_frozen_subject value = this }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_obligation_frozen_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_obligation_frozen_case value = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_obligation_frozen_state value = 3 }
    }
}

zg361_comp_ae_consume_due_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_due_gross value = var:zg361_comp_ae_due_frozen_gross }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = zg361_comp_due_treasury
        value = var:zg361_comp_ae_due_frozen_treasury
    }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = zg361_comp_due_personal
        value = var:zg361_comp_ae_due_frozen_personal
    }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:zg361_comp_due_gross >= 2
            scope:zg361_comp_due_treasury >= 1
            scope:zg361_comp_due_personal >= 1
            var:zg361_case_ae_owner = {
                has_treasury = yes
                treasury >= scope:zg361_comp_due_treasury
                gold >= scope:zg361_comp_due_personal
            }
            var:zg361_comp_ae_treasury_available >= scope:zg361_comp_due_treasury
            var:zg361_comp_ae_personal_available >= scope:zg361_comp_due_personal
        }
        zg361_comp_ae_pay_due_later_effect = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { scope:zg361_comp_due_gross = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_paid add = scope:zg361_comp_due_gross }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed value = 0 }
    }
    else = {
        # Typed insufficient-funds RED: both real payer balances and the
        # statement remain unchanged; the owed amount stays visible.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_payment_red value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 4 }
    }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_resolved value = 1 }
    zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = yes
    zg361_comp_ae_try_advance_03_effect = yes
}

# Subject-only response.  Counts/barons may answer their own case but this
# effect cannot open/advance a case, approve money, or call a manager core.
zg361_comp_ae_subject_appeal_response_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
            }
            var:zg361_case_ae_state = 5
            var:zg361_comp_ae_appeal_response_recorded = 0
            OR = { scope:zg361_comp_subject_route = 1 scope:zg361_comp_subject_route = 2 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_appeal_response_recorded value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_appeal_requested value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_subject_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_appeal_requested value = 1 } }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_case_ae_feedback_revision add = 1 }
            zg361_comp_portfolio_notify_owner_effect = { DOMAIN = 2 }
    }
}

zg361_comp_af_try_start_vesting_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m297_consumed = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m298_consumed = 1
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_vesting_ready value = 1 }
    }
}

zg361_comp_af_consume_vest_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_comp_af_vesting_ready = 1
            var:zg361_comp_af_periods_processed < var:zg361_comp_af_vesting_periods
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_cliff_consumed value = 1 }
        set_variable = {
            name = zg361_comp_af_service_tranche
            value = { value = var:zg361_comp_af_service_original divide = var:zg361_comp_af_vesting_periods floor = yes }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = zg361_comp_af_performance_tranche
            value = { value = var:zg361_comp_af_performance_original divide = var:zg361_comp_af_vesting_periods floor = yes }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_next_period value = { value = var:zg361_comp_af_periods_processed add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_comp_af_next_period = var:zg361_comp_af_vesting_periods }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_service_tranche value = var:zg361_comp_af_unvested_service }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_performance_tranche value = var:zg361_comp_af_unvested_performance }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes liege = var:zg361_case_af_owner }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_unvested_service add = { value = 0 subtract = var:zg361_comp_af_service_tranche } }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_vested_units add = var:zg361_comp_af_service_tranche }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    var:zg361_comp_m298_organization_gate = 1
                    var:zg361_comp_m298_individual_gate = 1
                }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_unvested_performance add = { value = 0 subtract = var:zg361_comp_af_performance_tranche } }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_vested_units add = var:zg361_comp_af_performance_tranche }
            }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_periods_processed add = 1 }
        zg361_comp_af_check_conservation_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = no var:zg361_case_af_owner = { is_ai = no } }
            trigger_event = { id = zg361comp.903 days = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_af_periods_processed < var:zg361_comp_af_vesting_periods
                var:zg361_comp_af_exit_requested = 0
            }
            zg361_comp_af_schedule_next_vest_effect = yes
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_vesting_complete value = 1 } }
        zg361_comp_portfolio_notify_owner_effect = { DOMAIN = 3 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_vesting_red value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 5 }
    }
}

# Manager-controlled exit barrier.  Repeated cadence events keep state 4 until
# this explicit request; vesting is therefore not collapsed into one transit.
zg361_comp_af_request_exit_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_comp_af_vesting_ready = 1
            var:zg361_comp_af_cliff_consumed = 1
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_exit_requested value = 1 }
        zg361_case_af_advance_04_effect = {
            TICKET_OWNER = root
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
        }
        zg361_comp_portfolio_notify_owner_effect = { DOMAIN = 3 }
    }
}

zg361_comp_af_consume_buyback_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
            var:zg361_comp_af_request_state = 1
            var:zg361_comp_af_vested_units >= 10
            var:zg361_comp_af_request_serial = { value = var:zg361_case_af_owner.var:zg361_comp_af_queue_head add = 1 }
            var:zg361_case_af_owner = { has_treasury = yes treasury >= 7 gold >= 3 }
            var:zg361_comp_af_treasury_available >= 7
            var:zg361_comp_af_personal_available >= 3
        }
        zg361_comp_af_pay_buyback_later_effect = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_vested_units add = -10 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_repurchased_units add = 10 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_request_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_repurchase_resolved value = 1 }
        var:zg361_case_af_owner = { change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_queue_head add = 1 } }
        zg361_comp_af_check_conservation_effect = yes
        zg361_comp_af_try_advance_05_effect = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
            var:zg361_comp_af_request_state = 1
            var:zg361_comp_af_vested_units >= 10
            var:zg361_comp_af_request_serial = { value = var:zg361_case_af_owner.var:zg361_comp_af_queue_head add = 1 }
        }
        # The delayed request reaches a terminal insufficient-funds outcome.
        # No balance or unit moved; advancing the FIFO releases later cases.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_buyback_red value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_request_state value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_repurchase_resolved value = 1 }
        var:zg361_case_af_owner = { change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_queue_head add = 1 } }
        zg361_comp_af_check_conservation_effect = yes
        zg361_comp_af_try_advance_05_effect = yes
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 5 } }
}

# Manager-scope portfolio adapter.  It owns one selected subject and one
# L/AE/AF case at a time; no numbered mechanism opens its own visible window.
zg361_comp_portfolio_open_next_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_game_rule = zg361_on
            zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
            has_variable = zg361_review_serial
            NOT = { has_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active }
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_completed_cycle }
                NOT = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_completed_cycle = var:zg361_review_serial }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_domain } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_domain value = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain = 1
                NOT = { has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject }
            }
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_cycle
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_owner
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_subject
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_cycle
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_case
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_state
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_snapshot_applied
            ordered_vassal = {
                limit = {
                    zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
                    liege = root
                    trigger_if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_variable = zg361_result_case_owner
                            has_variable = zg361_result_cycle_serial
                            has_variable = zg361_result_case_serial
                            has_variable = zg361_result_case_state
                            has_variable = zg361_result_grade
                            root = { has_variable = zg361_review_serial }
                        }
                        var:zg361_result_case_owner = root
                        var:zg361_result_cycle_serial = root.var:zg361_review_serial
                        var:zg361_result_case_state >= 3
                        OR = {
                            var:zg361_result_grade = 1
                            var:zg361_result_grade = 2
                            var:zg361_result_grade = 3
                        }
                    }
                    trigger_else = { always = no }
                }
                order_by = stewardship
                position = 0
                save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_comp_portfolio_selected
                zg361_comp_freeze_current_result_effect = yes
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain <= 3
                has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_cycle
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_owner
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_subject
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_cycle
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_case
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_state
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_result_snapshot_applied
                    }
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_cycle = var:zg361_review_serial
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_owner = root
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_subject = var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_cycle = var:zg361_review_serial
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_state >= 3
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_snapshot_applied = 1
                    OR = {
                        AND = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade = 1 var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating = 325 }
                        AND = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade = 2 var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating = 350 }
                        AND = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_grade = 3 var:zg361_comp_portfolio_result_rating = 375 }
                    }
                }
                trigger_else = { always = no }
            }
            if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain = 1 }
            var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = { zg361_comp_open_l_case_effect = yes }
        }
if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain = 2 }
            var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = { zg361_comp_open_ae_case_effect = yes }
        }
if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain = 3 }
            var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = { zg361_comp_open_af_case_effect = yes }
        }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = {
                        has_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
                        var:zg361_comp_runtime_applied = 1
                    }
                }
                add_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_visible_pending value = 0 }
                zg361_comp_portfolio_refresh_effect = yes
            }
            else = {
                if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain = 1 }
                    remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain > 3 }
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
            remove_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_domain
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_visible_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_completed_cycle value = var:zg361_review_serial }
        }
    }
}

zg361_comp_portfolio_apply_stage_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
            has_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
            has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route = 3
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_visible_pending value = 0 }
        if = {
        limit = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain = 1 }
        var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = {
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_l_state = 1 }
                zg361_comp_m082_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m083_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m084_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_l_state = 2 }
                zg361_comp_m085_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m086_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_l_state = 3 }
                zg361_comp_m087_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m088_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m089_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_l_state = 4 }
                zg361_comp_m090_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m091_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain = 2 }
        var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = {
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_ae_state = 1 }
                zg361_comp_m278_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m279_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m280_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_ae_state = 2 }
                zg361_comp_m281_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m282_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_ae_state = 3 }
                zg361_comp_m283_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m284_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m285_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_ae_state = 4 }
                zg361_comp_m286_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m287_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_ae_state = 5 }
                zg361_comp_m288_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m289_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain = 3 }
        var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = {
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_af_state = 1 }
                zg361_comp_m290_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m291_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m292_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_af_state = 2 }
                zg361_comp_m293_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m294_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_af_state = 3 }
                zg361_comp_m295_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m296_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_af_state = 4 }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m297_consumed = 1
                        var:zg361_comp_m298_consumed = 1
                        var:zg361_comp_af_cliff_consumed = 1
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route = 3 } }
                        zg361_comp_af_request_exit_effect = yes
                    }
                    else = {
                        # Snoozing records this vesting period. The next
                        # cadence tick may offer the one portfolio card again.
                        set_variable = {
                            name = zg361_comp_af_last_exit_offer_period
                            value = var:zg361_comp_af_periods_processed
                        }
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    zg361_comp_m297_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m298_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                }
            }
else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_af_state = 5 }
                zg361_comp_m299_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
                    zg361_comp_m300_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = scope:zg361_comp_portfolio_route }
            }
        }
    }
        zg361_comp_portfolio_refresh_effect = yes
    }
}

zg361_comp_portfolio_refresh_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
            has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
            OR = {
                AND = {
            var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain = 1
            var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = {
                var:zg361_case_l_active = 1
                OR = {
                    AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_l_state = 1
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m082_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m083_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m084_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_l_state = 2
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m085_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m086_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_l_state = 3
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m087_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m088_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m089_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_l_state = 4
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m090_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m091_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
                }
            }
        }
        AND = {
            var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain = 2
            var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = {
                var:zg361_case_ae_active = 1
                OR = {
                    AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_ae_state = 1
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m278_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m279_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m280_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_ae_state = 2
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m281_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m282_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_ae_state = 3
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m283_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m284_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m285_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_ae_state = 4
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m286_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m287_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_ae_state = 5
                    AND = {
                        var:zg361_comp_ae_appeal_response_recorded = 1
                        OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m288_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m289_consumed = 0
                    }
                    }
                }
                }
            }
        }
        AND = {
            var:zg361_comp_portfolio_domain = 3
            var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = {
                var:zg361_case_af_active = 1
                OR = {
                    AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_af_state = 1
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m290_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m291_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m292_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_af_state = 2
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m293_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m294_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_af_state = 3
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m295_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m296_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_af_state = 4
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m297_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m298_consumed = 0
                        AND = {
                            var:zg361_comp_m297_consumed = 1
                            var:zg361_comp_m298_consumed = 1
                            var:zg361_comp_af_cliff_consumed = 1
                            var:zg361_comp_af_exit_requested = 0
                            var:zg361_comp_af_last_exit_offer_period < var:zg361_comp_af_periods_processed
                        }
                    }
                }
AND = {
                    var:zg361_case_af_state = 5
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_comp_m299_consumed = 0
                        var:zg361_comp_m300_consumed = 0
                    }
                }
                }
            }
        }
            }
            var:zg361_comp_portfolio_visible_pending = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_visible_pending value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = yes }
            trigger_event = { id = zg361comp.2 days = 1 }
        }
        else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361comp.1 days = 1 } }
    }
}

# Called from a subject-scoped write, deadline, or barrier. Only the frozen
# case owner may clear/re-arm its currently selected portfolio card.
zg361_comp_portfolio_notify_owner_effect = {
    save_scope_as = zg361_comp_notify_subject
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_notify_domain value = $DOMAIN$ }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:zg361_comp_notify_domain = 1 has_variable = zg361_case_l_owner }
        var:zg361_case_l_owner = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
                    has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = scope:zg361_comp_notify_subject
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_visible_pending value = 0 }
                zg361_comp_portfolio_refresh_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { scope:zg361_comp_notify_domain = 2 has_variable = zg361_case_ae_owner }
        var:zg361_case_ae_owner = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
                    has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = scope:zg361_comp_notify_subject
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_visible_pending value = 0 }
                zg361_comp_portfolio_refresh_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { scope:zg361_comp_notify_domain = 3 has_variable = zg361_case_af_owner }
        var:zg361_case_af_owner = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
                    has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = scope:zg361_comp_notify_subject
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_visible_pending value = 0 }
                zg361_comp_portfolio_refresh_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

zg361_comp_portfolio_case_closed_effect = {
    save_scope_as = zg361_comp_closed_subject
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_closed_domain value = $DOMAIN$ }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:zg361_comp_closed_domain = 1 has_variable = zg361_case_l_owner }
        var:zg361_case_l_owner = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
                    has_variable = zg361_comp_portfolio_subject
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = scope:zg361_comp_closed_subject
                }
                remove_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_visible_pending value = 0 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_domain add = 1 }
                trigger_event = { id = zg361comp.3 days = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { scope:zg361_comp_closed_domain = 2 has_variable = zg361_case_ae_owner }
        var:zg361_case_ae_owner = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = scope:zg361_comp_closed_subject
                }
                remove_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_visible_pending value = 0 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_domain add = 1 }
                trigger_event = { id = zg361comp.3 days = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { scope:zg361_comp_closed_domain = 3 has_variable = zg361_case_af_owner }
        var:zg361_case_af_owner = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
                    var:zg361_comp_portfolio_subject = scope:zg361_comp_closed_subject
                }
                remove_character_flag = zg361_comp_portfolio_active
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_visible_pending value = 0 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_portfolio_domain add = 1 }
                trigger_event = { id = zg361comp.3 days = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m082_manager_apply_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = {
                zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                # No is_ai=no gate: the project-authorized AI manager uses this
                # same duke+ background resolver without opening player UI.
            }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
        }
        zg361_comp_m082_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 082 总回报公式
zg361_comp_m082_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m082_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m082_receipt_active = 0


        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_l_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_l_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_l_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m082_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m082_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m082_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m082_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m082_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m082_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 82
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m082_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m082_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m082_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m082_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m082_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m082_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m082_receipt_state = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m082_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m082_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m082_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m082_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_l_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_object_case value = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_object_state value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m082_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m082_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_l_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_fixed_pay value = 12 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_role_allowance value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_performance_bonus value = 14 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_spot_award value = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_deferred_award value = 6 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m082_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_performance_bonus value = 10 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_spot_award value = 6 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_deferred_award value = 6 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m082_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_performance_bonus value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_spot_award value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_deferred_award value = 0 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_total_reward value = var:zg361_comp_m082_fixed_pay }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_total_reward add = var:zg361_comp_m082_role_allowance }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_total_reward add = var:zg361_comp_m082_performance_bonus }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_total_reward add = var:zg361_comp_m082_spot_award }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_total_reward add = var:zg361_comp_m082_deferred_award }



        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m082_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_l_try_advance_01_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 082"
    }
}

zg361_comp_m083_manager_apply_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = {
                zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                # No is_ai=no gate: the project-authorized AI manager uses this
                # same duke+ background resolver without opening player UI.
            }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
        }
        zg361_comp_m083_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 083 天朝、团队与个人奖金系数
zg361_comp_m083_core_effect = {

    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m083_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m083_receipt_active = 0


        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_l_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_l_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_l_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m083_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m083_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m083_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m083_receipt_case

            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m083_receipt_route

            TICKET_SUBJECT = this

            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial

            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 83
        }
        if = {

            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }

                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m083_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m083_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {

                var:zg361_comp_m083_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m083_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m083_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m083_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m083_receipt_state = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m083_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }

# 084 递延奖金与兑现
zg361_comp_m084_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_active = 0

            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                var:zg361_case_l_owner = { has_treasury = yes treasury >= 14 gold >= 6 }
                var:zg361_comp_l_treasury_available >= 14
                var:zg361_comp_l_personal_available >= 6
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_personal_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_deferred_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_deferred_personal_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_held_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_held_personal_status = 0
            }
            trigger_else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 }
                var:zg361_case_l_owner = { has_treasury = yes treasury >= 11 gold >= 5 }
                var:zg361_comp_l_treasury_available >= 11
                var:zg361_comp_l_personal_available >= 5
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_personal_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_deferred_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_deferred_personal_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_held_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_held_personal_status = 0
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_l_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_l_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_l_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 84
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 3 } }
                zg361_comp_l_reserve_bonus_effect = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m084_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_state = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m084_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m084_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_l_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_case value = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_state value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m084_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m084_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_l_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_formula_locked value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_reserve_receipt value = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_frozen_total_reward value = var:zg361_comp_m082_total_reward }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_frozen_computed_bonus value = var:zg361_comp_m083_computed_bonus }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_frozen_gross value = var:zg361_comp_bonus_total }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_frozen_treasury value = var:zg361_comp_bonus_treasury_funded }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_frozen_personal value = var:zg361_comp_bonus_personal_funded }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_deferred_due_year value = { value = current_year add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m084_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_materialized value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_deferred_due_year value = 0 }
            }



        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_l_try_advance_01_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 084"
    }
}

# 085 留任激励断崖
zg361_comp_m085_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m085_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m085_receipt_active = 0


        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_l_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_l_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_l_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m085_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m085_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m085_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m085_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m085_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m085_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 2
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 85
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m085_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m085_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m085_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m085_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m085_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m085_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m085_receipt_state = 2
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m085_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m085_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m085_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m085_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_l_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_object_case value = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m085_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m085_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_l_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_last_vest_year value = current_year }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_next_grant_year value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m085_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_next_grant_year value = { value = current_year add = 2 } } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m085_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_next_grant_year value = { value = current_year add = 1 } } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_cliff_gap_years value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m085_next_grant_year > 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_cliff_gap_years value = { value = var:zg361_comp_m085_next_grant_year subtract = var:zg361_comp_m085_last_vest_year } } }



        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m085_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_l_try_advance_02_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 085"
    }
}

# 086 奖金暂扣与追回
zg361_comp_m086_core_effect = {
