    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m086_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m086_receipt_active = 0

            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 }
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_funded = 1
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_paid >= 2
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_clawback_status = 0
                gold >= 2
                var:zg361_case_l_owner = { has_treasury = yes }
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_l_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_l_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_l_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m086_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m086_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m086_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m086_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m086_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m086_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 2
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 86
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 }
                zg361_comp_l_clawback_bonus_effect = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m086_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m086_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m086_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m086_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m086_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m086_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m086_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m086_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m086_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m086_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m086_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m086_receipt_state = 2
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m086_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }

            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m087_route = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m087_salary value = 9 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m087_position_bps value = -1000 } }



        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m087_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_l_try_advance_03_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 087"
    }
}

# 088 市场调薪与绩效调薪
zg361_comp_m088_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m088_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m088_receipt_active = 0


        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_l_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_l_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_l_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m088_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m088_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m088_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m088_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m088_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m088_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 3
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 88
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m088_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m088_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m088_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m088_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m088_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m088_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m088_receipt_state = 3
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m088_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial

                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_l_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_object_case value = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_object_state value = 3 }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m088_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_l_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_raise_pool value = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_market_allocation value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_merit_allocation value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_fairness_allocation value = 3 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m088_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_market_allocation value = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_merit_allocation value = 5 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_fairness_allocation value = 3 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m088_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_raise_pool value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_market_allocation value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_merit_allocation value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_fairness_allocation value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_object_materialized value = 0 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_allocation_total value = var:zg361_comp_m088_market_allocation }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_allocation_total add = var:zg361_comp_m088_merit_allocation }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_allocation_total add = var:zg361_comp_m088_fairness_allocation }



        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m088_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_l_try_advance_03_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 088"
    }

# 090 专项即时奖
zg361_comp_m090_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m090_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m090_receipt_active = 0

            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                var:zg361_case_l_owner = { has_treasury = yes treasury >= 7 gold >= 3 }
                var:zg361_comp_l_treasury_available >= 7
                var:zg361_comp_l_personal_available >= 3
                var:zg361_comp_m090_pay_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_m090_pay_personal_status = 0
            }
            trigger_else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 }
                var:zg361_case_l_owner = { has_treasury = yes treasury >= 4 gold >= 2 }
                var:zg361_comp_l_treasury_available >= 4
                var:zg361_comp_l_personal_available >= 2
                var:zg361_comp_m090_bounded_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_m090_bounded_personal_status = 0
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_l_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_l_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_l_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m090_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m090_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m090_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m090_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m090_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m090_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 4
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 90
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                zg361_comp_l_pay_spot_effect = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 }
                zg361_comp_l_pay_spot_bounded_effect = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m090_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m090_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m090_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m090_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m090_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m090_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m090_receipt_state = 4
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m090_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m090_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m090_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m090_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_l_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_object_case value = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_object_state value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m090_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m090_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_l_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_spot_gross value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m090_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_spot_gross value = 10 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m090_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_spot_gross value = 6 } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_object_materialized value = 0 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_performance_slot_delta value = 0 }



        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m090_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_l_try_advance_04_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 090"
    }
}

    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = {
                zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                # No is_ai=no gate: the project-authorized AI manager uses this
                # same duke+ background resolver without opening player UI.
            }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
        }
        zg361_comp_m091_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 091 年功奖与绩效奖分账
zg361_comp_m091_core_effect = {

    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial

                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m091_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m091_receipt_active = 0


        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial

            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_l_revision

            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_l_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m091_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m091_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m091_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m091_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m091_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m091_receipt_route

            TICKET_SUBJECT = this

                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m091_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }

    else = {

    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial

                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4

            var:zg361_comp_m091_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m091_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_l_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_object_case value = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_object_state value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m091_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m091_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_l_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_tenure_award value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_performance_award value = 7 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m091_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_tenure_award value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_performance_award value = 2 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m091_route = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_tenure_award value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_performance_award value = 0 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_award_total value = var:zg361_comp_m091_tenure_award }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_award_total add = var:zg361_comp_m091_performance_award }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_source_spot_gross value = var:zg361_comp_m090_spot_gross }



        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m091_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_l_try_advance_04_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 091"
    }
}

            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m279_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m279_receipt_active = 0


        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ae_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ae_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m279_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m279_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m279_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m279_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m279_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m279_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 279
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m279_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m279_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m279_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m279_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m279_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m279_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m279_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m279_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m279_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m279_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m279_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m279_receipt_state = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m279_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m279_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m279_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m279_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_ae_revision }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m279_locked_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial }

        zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = yes

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m279_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_ae_try_advance_01_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 279"
    }
}

                # same duke+ background resolver without opening player UI.
            }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
        }
        zg361_comp_m280_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 280 年中入转离折算
zg361_comp_m280_core_effect = {

    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial

                EXPECTED_STATE = 1

            has_variable = zg361_comp_m280_receipt_active

        }

            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial

                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m280_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m280_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }

    }
    else = {

# 281 奖金支付日与延期信用
zg361_comp_m281_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = zg361_comp_due_gross
        value = var:zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed
    }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = zg361_comp_due_treasury
        value = { value = scope:zg361_comp_due_gross multiply = 0.7 add = 0.5 floor = yes }
    }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = zg361_comp_due_personal
        value = { value = scope:zg361_comp_due_gross subtract = scope:zg361_comp_due_treasury }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m281_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m281_receipt_active = 0

            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                scope:zg361_comp_due_gross >= 2
                scope:zg361_comp_due_treasury >= 1
                scope:zg361_comp_due_personal >= 1
                var:zg361_case_ae_owner = {
                    has_treasury = yes
                    treasury >= scope:zg361_comp_due_treasury
                    gold >= scope:zg361_comp_due_personal
                }
                var:zg361_comp_ae_treasury_available >= scope:zg361_comp_due_treasury
                var:zg361_comp_ae_personal_available >= scope:zg361_comp_due_personal
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ae_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ae_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m281_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m281_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m281_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m281_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m281_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m281_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 2
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 281
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                zg361_comp_ae_pay_due_now_effect = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m281_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m281_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m281_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m281_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m281_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m281_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m281_receipt_state = 2
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m281_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m281_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m281_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m281_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_ae_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_object_case value = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m281_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m281_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_ae_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_decision value = var:zg361_comp_m281_route }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m281_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_paid_amount value = scope:zg361_comp_due_gross }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_paid add = scope:zg361_comp_due_gross }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_resolved value = 1 }
            }
            else = {
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_delay_count add = 1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_credibility add = { value = 0 subtract = 15 } }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_new_due_days value = 90 }
                if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m281_route = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_new_due_days value = 180 } }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_due_resolved value = 0 }
            }

        zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = yes

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m281_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_ae_try_advance_02_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 281"
    }
}

    if = {

}

# 282 调薪生效日与追溯补发
zg361_comp_m282_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m282_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m282_receipt_active = 0

            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                var:zg361_case_ae_owner = {
                    has_treasury = yes
                    treasury >= 3
                    gold >= 1
                }
                var:zg361_comp_ae_treasury_available >= 3
                var:zg361_comp_ae_personal_available >= 1
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_comp_m282_pay_treasury_status }
                    var:zg361_comp_m282_pay_treasury_status = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ae_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ae_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m282_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m282_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m282_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m282_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m282_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m282_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 2
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 282
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                zg361_comp_ae_pay_backpay_effect = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m282_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m282_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m282_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m282_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m282_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m282_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m282_receipt_state = 2
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m282_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m282_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m282_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m282_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_ae_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_object_case value = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m282_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m282_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_ae_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_reason_code value = var:zg361_comp_m282_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_backpay value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m282_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_backpay value = 4 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable add = 4 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_paid add = 4 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m282_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_backpay value = 4 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable add = 4 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed add = 4 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_object_materialized value = 0 } }

        zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = yes

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m282_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_ae_try_advance_02_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 282"
    }
}

    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m283_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m283_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_ae_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_object_case value = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_object_state value = 3 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m283_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m283_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_ae_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_responsibility_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_cash_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_cash_raise value = 4 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m283_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_cash_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial add = 2 } }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_cash_raise value = 2 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m283_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_cash_due_cycle value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_cash_raise value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_object_materialized value = 0 }
            }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m283_cash_raise > 0 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable add = var:zg361_comp_m283_cash_raise }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed add = var:zg361_comp_m283_cash_raise }
            }

        zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = yes

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m283_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_ae_try_advance_03_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 283"
    }
}

}

zg361_comp_m284_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {

                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial

                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3

            var:zg361_comp_m284_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m284_consumed = 0

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m284_object_case value = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m284_object_state value = 3 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m284_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m284_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m284_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m284_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m284_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_ae_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m284_current_pay value = 20 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m284_target_pay value = 16 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m284_steps value = 2 }

            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m284_route = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m284_steps value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m284_next_cycle_delta value = -4 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_next_cycle_base_delta value = var:zg361_comp_m284_next_cycle_delta }

        zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = yes

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m284_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_ae_try_advance_03_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 284"
    }
}

# 285 同档调薪二次校准
zg361_comp_m285_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m285_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m285_receipt_active = 0


        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ae_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ae_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m285_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m285_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m285_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m285_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m285_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m285_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 3
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 285
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m285_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m285_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m285_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m285_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m285_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m285_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m285_receipt_state = 3
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m285_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m285_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m285_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m285_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_ae_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_object_case value = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_object_state value = 3 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m285_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m285_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_ae_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_frozen_grade value = var:zg361_comp_result_rating }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_raise_pool value = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_band_debt_allocation value = 6 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_scarcity_allocation value = 4 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m285_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_raise_pool value = 6 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_band_debt_allocation value = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_scarcity_allocation value = 4 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m285_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_raise_pool value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_band_debt_allocation value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_scarcity_allocation value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_object_materialized value = 0 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_allocation_total value = var:zg361_comp_m285_band_debt_allocation }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_allocation_total add = var:zg361_comp_m285_scarcity_allocation }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_subject_raise value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m285_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_subject_raise value = 4 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m285_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_subject_raise value = 2 } }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m285_subject_raise > 0 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable add = var:zg361_comp_m285_subject_raise }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed add = var:zg361_comp_m285_subject_raise }
            }

        zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = yes

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m285_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_ae_try_advance_03_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 285"
    }
}

            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ae_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ae_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m287_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m287_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m287_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m287_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m287_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m287_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 4
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 287
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m287_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m287_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m287_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m287_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m287_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m287_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m287_receipt_state = 4
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m287_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m287_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial

                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m287_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m287_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_ae_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_object_case value = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_object_state value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m287_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m287_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_ae_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_visibility_mode value = var:zg361_comp_m287_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_named_peer_salary_visible value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_own_salary_visible value = 1 }

        zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = yes

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m287_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_ae_try_advance_04_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 287"
    }
}

        limit = {
            root = {

                # same duke+ background resolver without opening player UI.
            }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial

                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active

                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
        }
        zg361_comp_m288_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 288 修复新老薪酬倒挂
zg361_comp_m288_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m288_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m288_receipt_active = 0


        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ae_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ae_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m288_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m288_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m288_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m288_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m288_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m288_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial

            OPERATION_ID = 288

            if = {

                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m288_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {

                var:zg361_comp_m288_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m288_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial

zg361_comp_m288_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m288_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m288_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_ae_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_object_case value = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_object_state value = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m288_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m288_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_ae_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_incumbent_salary value = 15 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_new_hire_salary value = 20 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_scarcity_allowance value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_repair_due value = 4 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m288_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_repair_due value = 2 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m288_route = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_repair_due value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_object_materialized value = 0 } }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m288_repair_due > 0 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable add = var:zg361_comp_m288_repair_due }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed add = var:zg361_comp_m288_repair_due }
            }

        zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = yes

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m288_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_ae_try_advance_05_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 288"
    }
}
