# 289 薪酬申诉与绩效申诉分轨
zg361_comp_m289_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m289_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m289_receipt_active = 0
            var:zg361_comp_ae_appeal_response_recorded = 1
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                var:zg361_comp_ae_appeal_requested = 1
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                var:zg361_case_ae_owner = {
                    has_treasury = yes
                    treasury >= 3
                    gold >= 1
                }
                var:zg361_comp_ae_treasury_available >= 3
                var:zg361_comp_ae_personal_available >= 1
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_comp_m289_pay_treasury_status }
                    var:zg361_comp_m289_pay_treasury_status = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ae_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ae_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ae_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ae_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ae_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_ae_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m289_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m289_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m289_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m289_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m289_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m289_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 5
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 289
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                zg361_comp_ae_pay_appeal_effect = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m289_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m289_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m289_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m289_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m289_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m289_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m289_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m289_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_ae_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m289_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m289_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_ae_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m289_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_ae_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m289_receipt_state = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m289_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

    if = {

                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable add = 4 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_paid add = 4 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m289_route = 2 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_payable add = 2 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_ae_statement_owed add = 2 }
            }

        zg361_comp_ae_recalculate_statement_effect = yes

        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m289_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_ae_try_advance_05_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 289"
    }

# 290 长期激励提名池
zg361_comp_m290_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m290_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m290_receipt_active = 0


        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_af_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_af_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_af_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m290_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m290_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m290_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m290_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m290_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m290_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 290
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m290_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m290_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m290_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m290_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m290_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m290_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m290_receipt_state = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m290_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m290_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m290_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m290_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_af_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_object_case value = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_object_state value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m290_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m290_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_af_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_result_owner value = var:zg361_comp_result_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_result_subject value = var:zg361_comp_result_subject }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_result_cycle value = var:zg361_comp_result_cycle }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_result_case value = var:zg361_comp_result_case }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_result_state value = var:zg361_comp_result_state }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_result_grade value = var:zg361_comp_result_grade }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_rating value = var:zg361_comp_result_rating }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_eligible value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m290_result_grade = 3 var:zg361_comp_m290_rating = 375 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_eligible value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_nomination_score value = 15 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m290_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_nomination_score value = 10 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m290_route = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_nomination_score value = 5 } }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_comp_m086_retention_risk } change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_nomination_score add = var:zg361_comp_m086_retention_risk } }



        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m290_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_af_try_advance_01_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 290"
    }
}

    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = {
                zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                # No is_ai=no gate: the project-authorized AI manager uses this
                # same duke+ background resolver without opening player UI.
            }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
        }
        zg361_comp_m291_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 292 高风险期权与限制份额
zg361_comp_m292_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_active = 0

            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 3 var:zg361_comp_m290_eligible = 1 }
                var:zg361_case_af_owner = {
                    has_treasury = yes
                    treasury >= 7
                    gold >= 3
                }
                var:zg361_comp_af_treasury_available >= 7
                var:zg361_comp_af_personal_available >= 3
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_comp_m292_cash_treasury_status }
                    var:zg361_comp_m292_cash_treasury_status = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_af_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_af_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_af_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 292
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 3 var:zg361_comp_m290_eligible = 1 }
                zg361_comp_af_pay_cash_alternative_effect = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m292_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_state = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

            var:zg361_comp_m292_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_af_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_object_case value = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_object_state value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m292_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m292_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_af_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_risk_kind value = var:zg361_comp_m292_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_cash_alternative value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_can_expire_worthless value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m290_eligible = 1 }
                if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m292_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_can_expire_worthless value = 1 } }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_comp_m292_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_grant_base_units value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_cash_alternative value = 10 }
                }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_object_materialized value = 0 } }


        zg361_comp_af_recalculate_units_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_af_try_advance_01_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 292"
    }
}

    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = {
                zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                # No is_ai=no gate: the project-authorized AI manager uses this
                # same duke+ background resolver without opening player UI.
            }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial

                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
        }
        zg361_comp_m293_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 293 自愿奖金转长期份额
zg361_comp_m293_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m293_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m293_receipt_active = 0

            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 var:zg361_comp_m290_eligible = 1 }
                var:zg361_case_af_owner = { has_treasury = yes treasury >= 4 gold >= 2 }
                var:zg361_comp_af_treasury_available >= 4
                var:zg361_comp_af_personal_available >= 2
                var:zg361_comp_m293_cash6_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_m293_cash6_personal_status = 0
            }
            trigger_else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 }
                var:zg361_case_af_owner = { has_treasury = yes treasury >= 7 gold >= 3 }
                var:zg361_comp_af_treasury_available >= 7
                var:zg361_comp_af_personal_available >= 3
                var:zg361_comp_m293_cash10_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_m293_cash10_personal_status = 0
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_af_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_af_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_af_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m293_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m293_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m293_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m293_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m293_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m293_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 2
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 293
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 var:zg361_comp_m290_eligible = 1 }
                zg361_comp_af_pay_conversion_remainder_effect = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 }
                zg361_comp_af_pay_unconverted_bonus_effect = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m293_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m293_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m293_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m293_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m293_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m293_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m293_receipt_state = 2
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m293_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m293_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m293_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m293_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_af_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_object_case value = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m293_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m293_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_af_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_voluntary value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_converted_cash value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_conversion_units value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_cash_remaining value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m293_route = 1 var:zg361_comp_m290_eligible = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_voluntary value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_converted_cash value = 4 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_conversion_units value = 4 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_cash_remaining value = 6 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m293_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_cash_remaining value = 10 } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_object_materialized value = 0 } }


        zg361_comp_af_recalculate_units_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m293_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_af_try_advance_02_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 293"
    }
}

        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m295_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m295_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m295_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m295_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m295_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m295_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m295_receipt_state = 3
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m295_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m295_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m295_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m295_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_af_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_object_case value = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_object_state value = 3 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m295_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m295_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_af_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_cliff_days value = 365 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m295_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_cliff_days value = 180 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m295_route = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_cliff_days value = 730 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_cliff_days value = var:zg361_comp_m295_cliff_days }



        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m295_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_af_try_advance_03_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 295"
    }
}

                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial

                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial

    }
}

# 296 月度、季度或年度归属
zg361_comp_m296_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m296_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m296_receipt_active = 0


        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_af_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_af_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_af_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m296_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m296_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m296_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m296_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m296_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m296_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 3
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 296
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m296_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m296_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m296_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m296_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m296_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m296_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m296_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m296_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m296_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m296_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m296_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m296_receipt_state = 3
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m296_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {

                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }

            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m298_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m298_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 4
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 298
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m298_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m298_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m298_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m298_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m298_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m298_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m298_receipt_state = 4
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m298_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m298_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m298_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m298_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_af_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_object_case value = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_object_state value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m298_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m298_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_af_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_organization_gate value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_individual_gate value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m298_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_individual_gate value = 0 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m298_route = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_organization_gate value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_individual_gate value = 0 } }



        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m298_consumed value = 1 }
        zg361_comp_af_try_start_vesting_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 298"
    }
}

                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
        }
        zg361_comp_m299_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 299 善意与恶意离任分类
zg361_comp_m299_core_effect = {

    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial

                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m299_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m299_receipt_active = 0


        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial

            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_af_feedback_revision

            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_route

            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m299_receipt_subject

            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m299_receipt_case

                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m299_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m299_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {

            }
        }

    }

        zg361_comp_af_check_conservation_effect = yes

# 300 回购窗口与流动性队列
zg361_comp_m300_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m300_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m300_receipt_active = 0
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 3 } }
                var:zg361_comp_af_vested_units >= 10
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                var:zg361_case_af_owner = {
                    has_treasury = yes
                    treasury >= 7
                    gold >= 3
                }
                var:zg361_comp_af_treasury_available >= 7
                var:zg361_comp_af_personal_available >= 3
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_comp_m300_buyback_treasury_status }
                    var:zg361_comp_m300_buyback_treasury_status = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                    var:zg361_comp_af_vested_units >= 10
                    var:zg361_case_af_owner = {
                        var:zg361_comp_af_queue_tail = var:zg361_comp_af_queue_head
                    }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_af_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_af_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_af_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m300_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m300_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m300_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m300_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m300_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m300_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 5
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 300
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                zg361_comp_af_pay_buyback_now_effect = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m300_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m300_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m300_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m300_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m300_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m300_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m300_receipt_state = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m300_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m300_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m300_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m300_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_af_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_object_case value = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_object_state value = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m300_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m300_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_af_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_window_open value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_requested_units value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { OR = { var:zg361_comp_m300_route = 1 var:zg361_comp_m300_route = 2 } }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_window_open value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_requested_units value = 10 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_object_materialized value = 0 } }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:zg361_comp_m300_route = 1 var:zg361_comp_m300_route = 2 } }
            var:zg361_case_af_owner = { change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_queue_tail add = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_request_serial value = var:zg361_case_af_owner.var:zg361_comp_af_queue_tail }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_request_state value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_repurchase_resolved value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m300_route = 1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_vested_units add = -10 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_repurchased_units add = 10 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_request_state value = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_repurchase_resolved value = 1 }
                var:zg361_case_af_owner = { change_variable = { name = zg361_comp_af_queue_head add = 1 } }
            }
            else = { zg361_case_kernel_schedule_deadline_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
            DEADLINE_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_af_buyback_90_deadline_owner
            DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_af_buyback_90_deadline_subject
            DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_af_buyback_90_deadline_cycle
